title: Mem2A commit
description: The agent's report of what it did, against the latest dossier version it has read. Sent by the agent as a data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.commit+json`) in a follow-up message on the same task.

basedOn.description: The version of the latest dossier the agent has read: normally the one it acted on, or, after a `stale-dossier` error, the current one. Memory refuses the commit unless it equals the task's current dossier version.

action.description: The action taken. SHOULD equal the intent's `action`.

summary.description: What the agent did, in one plain sentence.

claims.description: What is now true because of the action. Each becomes a fact with status `claim`.

conflicts.description: Items of the `basedOn` dossier that the action, already taken, goes against. Required for every such item, whether or not the commit was refused as stale first. Memory records them and routes them to a person. Each id at most once, and each must name an item of the `basedOn` dossier.
